text:
Alex Chen: Heads up — need a one-pager for enterprise security + SLAs oriented at on-prem and VPC customers. Goal: field enablement + webinar signup asset. Draft by next Wed?
Samira Patel: +1. Suggest we include: quick benefits, deployment modes, SLA tiers, KMS/HSM notes, bench summary (latency/cost), and lead flow.
Marco Ruiz: I'll pull benchmark snippets from the recent perf run and a short p50/p99 table.
Jenna Gomez: For messaging — audience is platform/security engineers. Lead hook: 'Predictable inference. Enterprise controls.' Keep it 1-page.
Alex Chen: Assign: Samira (copy + deck), Marco (bench numbers + diagram), Jenna (sales routing + webinar blurb). I'll own design handoff and field notes.
Samira Patel: timeline: draft by Tue EOD, review Wed AM, finalize Thu for webinar promo.
Marco Ruiz: Question: should we include Dedicated vs Hosted cost delta? small table yes — shows typical unit cost and latency tradeoffs.
Jenna Gomez: For inbound routing, use this intake rule snippet (for ops/sales ops):
`if enterprise=true & compliance=high -> sales.queue=enterprise-security`
`if trial_tokens>10000 -> assign=dedicated-sales`
Alex Chen: Add CTA: 'Request security brief + SLA terms' (link: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-enterprise-brief) and webinar CTA.
Ops Bot: @alex Created doc: https://docs.internal.redwood.com/briefs/1923 (auto) :white_check_mark:
Samira Patel: Quick wire: header, 3 bullets (SLA, Deploy modes, Security integrations), a compact benchmark box (p50/p99 throughput), and contact CTA.
Marco Ruiz: Bench snippet (placeholder): `p50=35ms/token, p99=210ms/token, cost_delta=0.37x vs baseline` — will verify numbers before final.
Jenna Gomez: Webinar plan: 30-min technical talk + 15-min Q&A. Title idea: 'Serving LLMs at Scale: SLAs, Security, and Deployment Choices'
Alex Chen: Marketing will push webinar to a targeted accounts list. Samira please drop proposed messaging AB variants in #marketing for review.
Samira Patel: AB variants ready: 1) Security-first (NDA, KMS/HSM, audit logs) 2) Cost & predictability (batching, quantization) 3) Hybrid/private deployment (VPC, on-prem).
Marco Ruiz: I'll upload diagrams to drive: /Marketing/Enterprise/Deploy-modes/diag_v1.png
Jenna Gomez: Sales ops — need a copyable routing snippet for downstream automation: 
```
if lead.company_size > 500 & lead.interest == 'enterprise' {
  assign = 'enterprise-AC'
  route_forms = ['security_brief','sla_request']
}
```
Samira Patel: tagging @Matt Sales for intake rule approval.
Matt Sales: OK from PMM side. Will check with legal for NDA phrasing; fine to proceed.
Alex Chen: Can we also get a 1-line social teaser + 2 bullets by Fri? Marketing needs it for the webinar promo.
Samira Patel: Draft teaser: 'Predictable LLM inference for regulated teams. Get SLA-backed throughput and private deployments.'
Alex Chen: Perfect. I'll queue design and schedule a 30-min sync with ops/design tomorrow. Thanks team :rocket:
